question:
I am quite new to dbtvault and I was wondering where should I put the profile.yml file? I am trying to run the sample code which is in official docs (https://github.com/Datavault-UK/dbtvault-snowflakeDemo/releases).when I try to run the sql scripts, I have the error shown below

I tried running dbt run --help, it is said the default directory to look into is C:\Users\Username.dbt and I tried placing the profile.yml file in that location. But it doesnt seem to work. Could anyone suggest me on what needs to be done here ?
title: dbtvault error when running the model ERROR: Runtime Error Could not find profile named 'dbtvault_snowflake_demo'
answer:
When calling dbt from the command line, dbt will parse your dbt_Project.yml and obtain the profile name.

dbt will search for the profiles.yml file in the current working directory. If not found, it defaults to the ~/.dbt/ directory.

I was wondering where should I put the profile.yml file?

The default path for profiles.yml is ~/.dbt/
